audit_kind: Source-level theorem statement fidelity; no Lean kernel check by the auditor
comparison_method: Independently strip nested block comments and line comments; compare every public theorem declaration before := by after whitespace normalization, including attributes, hypotheses and conclusion; also compare namespace/variable/include/omit/section context.
limitations: This compares source declarations and explicit section context, not kernel-elaborated signatures or dependency identity. The additional open ArithmeticCumulative fixes name resolution in one module; definitions and theorem declaration text there are unchanged.
